newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Monday. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test at the close.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was rather light. Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and no slaughter heifers. For the week to date including late Friday and the weekend 6,400 head confirmed including 3,600 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - few select with end choice 2-3 1200 lbs 67.00.
